name: git-file-history-cdm
description: Modern, fast and intuitive tool for browsing the history and files in any git repository

scripts.build-site: cd .. && cross-env SKIP_PREFLIGHT_CHECK=true NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider PUBLIC_URL=. REACT_APP_GIT_PROVIDER=vscode craco build && node -e "require('fs').rmSync('vscode-ext/site',{recursive:true,force:true});require('fs').cpSync('build','vscode-ext/site',{recursive:true})"
